name: E Commerce Sales Monitor
prompt: Build an e-commerce sales monitor. Put a global date range picker at the very top. I need KPI metrics for Gross Sales, Net Conversions, and Cart Abandonment. Include an area chart showing daily gross sales vs net sales, and a small pie chart showing traffic sources.

thought_process.interpretation: I identified the persona as an Operations Manager or Business Analyst requiring a 'Process Monitor' archetype dashboard. The goal is to provide a real-time health check of e-commerce performance, focusing on sales volume, conversion efficiency, and abandonment friction. I have structured the layout with a sticky global header for temporal control, followed by a responsive KPI grid and descriptive visualizations for trend and composition analysis.
assumed_from_scratch: Responsive Chart Grid (Area vs Pie ratio)
Temporal data generation logic for 30-day trends
thought_process.skill_suggestions: A specialized 'metric_comparison.md' skill for side-by-side KPI trend comparisons would be beneficial for deeper diagnostic dashboards.
